scope: Bounded Prometheus schema v2, advanced execution metrics, operational metrics, dashboards, alerts, and optional host-only OTLP tracing

evidence: loopback metrics endpoint and serving contracts
HTTP 503 with telemetry source unavailable on exporter failure
bounded capability, scheduler, segmented-MTP, COW, Spomin, HTTP, and advanced-execution labels
lazy disabled tracing and enabled OTLP batch-processor setup

mlx_free_control_plane_regressions.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest --noconftest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_core.py tests/test_qualification.py tests/test_adapter_registry.py tests/test_batch_metrics.py tests/test_context_compaction.py tests/test_prometheus.py -q -k 'not http_metrics_endpoint'

serving_ownership_prefix.notes: The first eleven MLX-free ownership tests passed. The next test imports APCv2 and was excluded from qualification after the environment rejected MLX device initialization.

mlx_import_guard.evidence: prometheus, batch_metrics, server, serving, and tracing imported while a meta-path guard rejected mlx and mlx.*

evidence: Grafana dashboard is valid JSON with six panels
Prometheus rule file is valid YAML with eight alert rules

qualification_boundaries.gpu_or_metal: Explicitly excluded. No GPU test, model load, Metal kernel, or GPU-backed server was run.
qualification_boundaries.live_model_metrics: No claim is made about values under a real model workload.
qualification_boundaries.otlp_delivery: SDK construction and asynchronous batch-processor wiring were exercised without sending spans to a live collector.
qualification_boundaries.alert_thresholds: Rules are structurally validated examples, not SLO or performance qualification.
qualification_boundaries.apcv2_runtime: The queried-token and resident-capacity additions were compile-checked; APCv2 runtime tests require MLX and were not run.

environment_events.summary: An attempted broader serving suite imported MLX and aborted because this headless environment has no Metal device. The attempt was stopped and is not counted as a passing CPU test.
Loopback-only HTTP tests required permission to bind temporary localhost sockets; the CPU-only suite then passed.
